# Neesh

Neesh is a wholesale marketplace for independent magazines. It connects independent publishers with design-forward retailers.

## How it works

Retailers browse curated titles and order at wholesale prices. Publishers ship direct to the retailer.

## Who it is for

**Retailers.** Design-forward spaces that want independent print no one else nearby carries.

**Publishers.** Independent magazine publishers who want their titles on curated retail shelves without building a distribution operation.

## Curated packs

Neesh currently offers five curated magazine packs built for non-traditional retail spaces such as offices, spas, clinics, gyms, boutique hotels, and wine bars.

Each pack is $200 flat with shipping included. A $300 premium tier adds a wooden display stand made in Portland, Oregon.

The five packs are The Waiting Room, The Studio, The Listening Room, The Locker Room, and Table Service. Each is themed for the kind of room it sits in. Retailers own every copy outright, with no consignment and no returns paperwork.

Presale closes September 19. Packs ship the first week of October.
